name: survos/elastic-bundle
description: Elasticsearch index lifecycle for Symfony: create/populate/status, and Doctrine change spooling. The query and faceted-UI half lives in survos/search-bundle.

suggest.doctrine/orm: For the postFlush spool listener that records changed entity ids.
suggest.survos/jsonl-bundle: For JSONL spool files (shared with survos/meili-bundle's spooler).
suggest.symfony/messenger: To flush the spool asynchronously instead of via elastic:spool:flush.
